posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
The Dreamer's projections would have to change their appearances to somewhat less freaky ones and go around singing happy songs and producing rainbows and stuff ;).

La Capitan would have to travel around giving the stuff she'd stolen back to the people she'd stolen it from, and then maybe give some pleasure rides to people to the location of their choice anywhere in space-time, like a free holiday.

Citizen Dawn could use her powers to ensure that no barbecue gets rained on for a few weeks or so. She'd probably complain that Ra could easily do that instead but he's not the one being punished for trying to take over the world and stuff ;).

The Wager Master would have to do something really long and tedious and which involves absolutely nothing being left to chance, no possibility of something random happening to alter the outcome or otherwise make things interesting for him.

Kaargra would have to move her arena somewhere it wasn't in anyone's way and then go around cleaning it up with a toothbrush or similar utensil - I'm sure there's plenty of bits of old competitor in there that have got right into the cracks...

Hmm, that's about all I can be arsed to think of for now. Maybe I'll come up with some more later :D.
